title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - ServiceProblemEventRecord
description: ServiceProblemEventRecord is a record of an event (related to a service problem) received from another system. It is a system-generated record that captures events related to a ServiceProblem, such as status changes, updates, acknowledgements, or resolution activities. It is not created directly by API consumers and serves as an audit and traceability mechanism for problem management activities. (TM Forum TMF656 Service Problem Management 5.1.0, OpenAPI component ServiceProblemEventRecord; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

ExternalIdentifier.description: An identification of an entity that is owned by or originates in a software system different from the current system, for example a ProductOrder handed off from a commerce platform into an order handling system. The structure identifies the system itself, the nature of the entity within the system (e.g. class name) and the unique ID of the entity within the system. It is anticipated that multiple external IDs can be held for a single entity, e.g. if the entity passed through multiple systems on the way to the current system. In this case the consumer is expected to sequence the IDs in the array in reverse order of provenance, i.e. most recent system first in the list.

owner.description: Name of the external system that owns the entity.

externalIdentifierType.description: Type of the identification, typically would be the type of the entity within the external system

id.description: identification of the entity within the external system.

ServiceProblem.description: A Service Problem is an indication that a service is no longer functioning according to the agreement with its client(s). It is a condition where a service fails to meet its expected performance, availability, or quality standards, resulting in a negative impact on the customer experience or business operations.

affectedLocation.description: A list of the locations affected by the problem. At least one of affectedResource, affectedService or affectedLocation should be present.

affectedResource.description: A list of the resources affected by the problem. At least one of affectedResource, affectedService or affectedLocation should be present.

affectedService.description: List of affected services. At least one of affectedResource, affectedService or affectedLocation should be present.

note.description: A list of comments or notes made on the problem

externalIdentifier.description: A list of external identifiers assoicated with this problem

characteristic.description: A list of additional properties/data items that describe or characterize this service problem. Please note that this list is currently unconstrained but in a future version this property might be constrained by a specification or deprecated altogether.

impactImportanceFactor.description: Impact Importance is characterized by an Impact Importance Factor: overall importance of the impact of all the affected services, e.g. 0 (zero impact) to 100 (worst impact). The Impact Importance is a calculated field which is set by the OSS determining the impact.

originatingSystem.description: Indicates in which system the problem was generated. Example: CRM Systems, Assurance System, etc.

parentProblem.description: The parent problem to which this problem is attached.

problemEscalation.description: Indicates if this service problem has been escalated or not. Possible values are 0 to 10. A value of zero means no escalation. The meanings of values 1-10 are to be determined by the user of the interface, but they show increasing levels of escalation.

relatedEvent.description: List of events associated to this problem

relatedEntity.description: List of entities associated with this problem. Example: Reference to TroubleTicket, Alarm etc.

relatedParty.description: List of parties or party roles playing a role within the service problem

rootCauseResource.description: Resource(s) that are associated to the underlying service problems that are the Root Cause of this one if any (used only if applicable).

rootCauseService.description: Service(s) that are associated to the underlying service problems that are the Root Cause of this one if any (used only if applicable)

statusChangeDate.description: Time the problem was last status changed

lastUpdate.description: Time the problem was last changed

trackingRecord.description: List of tracking records that allow the tracking of modifications on the problem.The tracking records should not be embedded in the problem to allow retrieving the problem without the tracking records

underlyingAlarm.description: A list of alarms underlying this problem.

slaViolation.description: A List of SLA violations associated with this problem.

troubleTicket.description: A list of trouble tickets associated with this problem.

underlyingProblem.description: A list of underlying problems. Relevant only if this problem is derived from other problems.

errorMessage.description: A list of the error(s) associated to the Service Problem. This object is used for any asynchronous errors and error information to be shared with consumer.

category.description: Classifier for the problem. Settable. For example, this is used for distinguish the category of problem originator in [role].[category] format. Example: serviceProvider.declarer, supplier.originated, system.originated

description.description: Free form text describing the Service Problem

priority.description: An indication varying from 1 (highest) to 10 (lowest) of how important it is for the service provider to correct the Service Problem.

reason.description: Reason, if known, for the service problem that will assist the Service Provider in understanding the underlying cause or contributing factors, enabling more accurate diagnosis and resolution. This can be set to Unknown, otherwise.

ServiceProblemEventNotificationType.description: A notification from the possible Events for Service Problem (such as creation, status change, information required, change).

ServiceProblemStateType.description: The life cycle status of the service problem, such as acknowledged, rejected, inProgress, resolved etc...
